reports.standfirst: Liverpool beat Brentford 2-1, recovering from a goal down after Yehor Yarmoliuk's dismissal in first-half stoppage time.
reports.account:
Dominik Szoboszlai was hurt and replaced after 32 minutes. Brentford moved ahead in the 44th minute, Keane Lewis-Potter heading Igor Thiago's pass into the top corner from inside the box. Yarmoliuk was then shown a straight red card eight minutes into first-half stoppage time, so Brentford took a one-goal lead into the interval with ten men on the pitch.
Jeremie Frimpong was lost to a fitness problem after 52 minutes. Víctor Muñoz equalised from Florian Wirtz's pass on the break, his shot, low and left-footed, finding the corner. Alexander Isak then gave Liverpool the lead on 70 minutes, turning in Bradley Barcola's header from close range. Vitaly Janelt was sent off for two bookings in stoppage time.

sections.head: Igor Thiago supplies Lewis-Potter
sections.pitch: Keane Lewis-Potter has scored twice in the league this season. Igor Thiago, who set up the header, attempted three shots and collected two defensive points.
sections.stake: Bayern Bru has Lewis-Potter on the bench, for six points; The Truffle Pigs has Igor Thiago on the bench, for six points against Bayern Bru.

sections.head: Isak reaches five
sections.pitch: Alexander Isak scored the winner against Brentford, and it took his league total for the campaign up to five goals.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him on the bench, for six points against its_ohi.

sections.head: Muñoz levels it up
sections.pitch: Víctor Muñoz's equaliser came from one of his three shots on Brentford's goal, taking his league tally for this season to two.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Igor Thiago 6 (The Truffle Pigs), Lewis-Potter 6 (Bayern Bru), Isak 6 (GlengarryHearts), Muñoz 6

reports.standfirst: Chelsea won 2-0 at Everton with two goals from Pedro Neto.
reports.account: Neto broke the deadlock for Chelsea just after half-time, striking a low left-footed shot into the corner from inside the penalty area. Emiliano Martínez needed replacing because of an injury after 75 minutes. Neto struck again from a set piece in the 90th minute, this time low into the bottom corner.

sections.head: Neto doubles up
sections.pitch: Pedro Neto's brace took him to three goals for the league season. He had three shots, created five chances for teammates and collected one defensive point.
sections.stake: Bayern Bru has him, for 13 points.

sections.head: Colwill, Lacroix concede nothing
sections.pitch: Levi Colwill and Maxence Lacroix were both on the pitch for every minute, and Chelsea kept Everton off the scoresheet from first whistle to last.
sections.stake: Cowthenbeef claimed Colwill on Friday, for six points; AtleticoTimHortons has Lacroix, for six points.

reports.standfirst: Fulham beat Hull City 1-0 to climb out of the bottom three with their first win of the season.
reports.account:
Alex Iwobi scored after 33 minutes, collecting Sander Berge's pass inside the box and finishing right-footed, low in the corner. Josh King and Oscar Bobb were both withdrawn through injury after 78 minutes.
Ryan Sessegnon was sent off in added time. Hull's Robinio Vaz was forced off deep into stoppage time, with no changes remaining.

sections.head: Leno, Affengruber unbeaten
sections.pitch: David Affengruber and Bernd Leno were on the pitch from start to finish, and Fulham kept Hull from scoring throughout.
sections.stake: If anyone can, Bannan can claimed Affengruber on Wednesday, for six points; The Raccoons claimed Leno on Wednesday, for six points against If anyone can, Bannan can.

sections.head: Sessegnon sees red
sections.pitch: Ryan Sessegnon was one of Fulham's substitutes, so his dismissal came after he had joined the match from the bench.
sections.stake: domeitalycoach claimed him on Friday, for minus two points against Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza.

reports.standfirst: Manchester City stay top with a seventh win in a row, 3-2 against Ipswich Town.
reports.account:
Phil Foden put City ahead after 19 minutes, finishing Jérémy Doku's pass on the break left-footed into the centre of the goal. Ipswich were level two minutes after Foden's goal, Daizen Maeda converting Abdoul Ouattara's pass low into a corner. Erling Haaland restored the lead after 34 minutes, heading Mateo Kovacic's cross low into the corner.
An injury ended Kovacic's match after 50 minutes. Haaland added City's third in the 69th minute on a counter, taking Iliman Ndiaye's pass and shooting straight down the middle. Matheus Nunes also came off hurt after 76 minutes.
Haaland had another goal ruled out after a video review five minutes from time, Enzo Fernández having set it up. The substitute Zian Flemming, on for Emersonn, converted a penalty in the 90th minute, right-footed into the middle of the goal.

sections.head: Maeda's equaliser
sections.pitch: Daizen Maeda's was the only one of Ipswich's two goals against City to come from open play, Flemming's later one being a penalty.
sections.stake: A free agent since Bayern Bru let him go on Wednesday; six points.

sections.head: Ndiaye's assist, Foden's goal
sections.pitch: Phil Foden managed three shots and created three openings for others. Iliman Ndiaye had four shots, with chances good enough to score among them.
sections.stake: AtleticoTimHortons has Foden, for seven points; Cowthenbeef has Ndiaye, for five points against AtleticoTimHortons.

reports.standfirst: Aston Villa won 1-0 at Newcastle United through Johan Manzambi's first-half header.
reports.account:
Joe Willock had a chance after 15 minutes, sending Lewis Hall's pass wide from the six-yard box. Manzambi met João Gomes's cross at close range after 36 minutes, heading it low inside the corner.
Injury cut short Manzambi's match after 72 minutes. Aaron Wan-Bissaka followed him off hurt after 77 minutes.

sections.head: Manzambi's winner, then injury
sections.pitch: Johan Manzambi took three shots, and his winner for Villa lifted him to two goals in league matches this season.
sections.stake: Cowthenbeef has him, for eight points.

sections.head: Suzuki keeps Newcastle out
sections.pitch: Zion Suzuki played every minute for Villa, and Newcastle were held goalless with him on the pitch throughout the match.
sections.stake: A free agent since Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza let him go on Thursday; eight points.
